independent_work_item: 07 — İzin öncesi açıklama, birleşik izin kontrolü ve kurulum sürdürme
principle: Developer/app access readiness, merchant scope grant, selected asset access and product setup readiness are separate observations; none implies the others.

google_ads.setup_complete_requires: Both grants and verified account/asset authority
google_ads.partial_or_cancelled: Resume Setup for incomplete chosen connection; no silent successful setup or automatic disconnect
google_ads.missing_merchant_account: Explicit unavailable account/asset condition; combined requirement also affects Search-only merchants
google_ads.developer_gate: Google Cloud project API access level and OAuth verification; Merchant API enablement/registration/verification as applicable; current approved status not established by this review

meta.request_together: Ads and Catalog permission profile; reuse exact existing dependency-closed scope set only after official/app configuration recheck
meta.scope_set_provenance: app/lib/oauth/oauth-permission-profile.server.js; current official permission reference fetch blocked, not newly verified
meta.setup_complete_requires: All required grants plus selected business/Ads/catalog access verified
meta.partial_or_cancelled: Resume Setup for incomplete chosen connection; do not mark Connected or silently disconnect
meta.developer_gate: App permission/access-level/review and business/asset prerequisites separately verified; own-app test access is not general merchant approval

klaviyo.permission_name: Klaviyo OAuth reporting/event access, not Ads API
klaviyo.estimated_monthly_cost: Separate user-entered setup value, not an API scope; preserve existing zero/missing distinction and source currency rules
klaviyo.missing_cost: Existing Resume Setup; resume existing verified account/spend stage rather than restarting OAuth when grants remain valid
klaviyo.developer_gate: OAuth app declared scopes and production/public distribution state verified separately; Marketplace approval is distinct from ability to install an unreviewed OAuth app

shopify.base_product_requirement: Product read access required for product-enabled setup; do not infer it from installation/session success
shopify.base_denial: Incomplete product setup => Resume Setup when app is installed; denial of native required installation permissions means installation is not completed

orders.initial_decline: Base product setup remains completed if its own requirements pass; order/overlap feature not authorized; no order job admission
orders.later_entry: Overlap action in existing report surface is proposed; final UI location and exact copy require analyst/owner acceptance
orders.pre_consent_copy_intent: Explain order access is needed to inspect overlap; Cancel keeps current base connection, Connect invokes native Shopify permission request
orders.dynamic_requirement: Declare needed scope in deployed optional_scopes before dynamic request; verify native grants after return; no automatic grant or read on Cancel
orders.older_than_60_days: read_all_orders only when needed with read_orders; app approval and merchant grant separately checked
orders.protected_customer_data: Minimum order/line/journey fields and applicable Shopify protected-data approval; no blanket read_customers/name/email/address access added
orders.marketing_events: read_marketing_events only for specifically used and separately explained features; not silently bundled as an Order permission

shopify.modal_constraint: Our embedded modal cannot precede native installation. Target is existing minimal installation followed by in-app Products permission request; read_products and read_orders must be declared in optional_scopes and released in a separately authorized config change. Products is required by product setup; Orders is optional for base setup. No TOML mutation here.
target_sequence: Native minimal Shopify installation establishes store context
First in-app product setup explanation; request read_products declared optional natively but required by product setup
Missing Products => Resume Setup with no product-enabled activation
Do not request Orders as a base completion requirement
Later Overlap explanation; request read_orders only on Connect

pre_permission_modal.scope: All providers and later Shopify Orders permission request
must_explain: What data we use and why
Which setup step remains incomplete if declined
Which Shopify Orders feature is optional and can be connected later
pre_permission_modal.must_not_claim: Google/Meta permission grants are read-only where native scopes permit writes; distinguish app read-only behavior from provider-granted scope breadth
behaviors: Connect starts exactly the explained permission flow
Return verifies actual scopes and assets
Separate missing merchant grant from missing developer approval; user reauthorization cannot cure app approval deficiency
No automatic retries, provider fallback, revocation or clearing other connections
Reconnect/revocation updates feature readiness; scopes alone do not activate jobs or establish overlap
pre_permission_modal.UI_gate: Existing Shopify embedded UI constitution, analyst brief, official components, desktop/mobile and owner acceptance required before UI implementation/Done

known_code_work.oauth_profile_selection: Existing reporting_v1 and identity_v1 remain separate in code; new Google/Meta setup must intentionally choose complete profile. Recorded target, not changed.
known_code_work.shopify_permission_preflight: Product-only default and explicit includeOrders checks prepared in first code delivery; order reader opts in before and after collection. Scope comparison is not completed setup, native access or activation; see Shopify_product_order_permission_split_2026_10_29.
known_code_work.orders_later_permission: Configure optional scopes in a separately authorized app-config delivery; add controlled request/return/currentAppInstallation validation and feature-specific readiness.
known_code_work.runtime_change: Permission assessment helpers and explicit Order collector scope option only; no new route or live activation.

developer_approval_audit.interpretation: Historical test/OAuth success and requested scope strings do not establish current all-merchant or new Merchant/Catalog/Orders access approval.
